standard.note: Fla. Const. art. X sec. 24 as amended by Amendment 2 (2020): +$1.00 every September 30 to $15.00 in 2026, then annual CPI indexing. Florida's step date is 2026-09-30 -- THREE WEEKS after this file's asOf date, so the $14.00 here is correct today and wrong from 2026-09-30. 2027: $15.00 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: Florida's tip credit is fixed at $3.02 by the constitution, so the tipped cash wage steps with the standard rate: $11.98 from 2026-09-30.

indexation.note: Indexing only resumes after the legislated $15.00 step.
